rows.behavior: The Claude and Antigravity packages' hooks.json hold only kmctl's SessionStart hook (Antigravity also keeps its okf Stop check), and the OpenCode plugin kmctl writes has no execute.after hook.
rows.fails_when: any shipped hooks.json has a PostToolUse entry, or the OpenCode plugin source contains execute.after
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_plugin.py tests/test_opencode.py tests/test_apm_package.py -q

rows.behavior: kmctl summary nudge no longer exists (kmctl summary --help lists only ack) and kmctl doctor has no nudge-hook check for any harness.
rows.fails_when: kmctl summary nudge exits 0, the summary help lists nudge, or doctor --json has a check id ending in nudge-hook

rows.behavior: Nothing under src/, apm/, docs/ or README.md mentions the nudge, and a decision supersedes ADR 0028, restoring the one-hook rule, with I1 naming one hook.
rows.fails_when: grep -ri nudge matches in those paths, ADR 0028's status is not deprecated, or no decision says it supersedes ADR 0028
rows.command: bash -c '! grep -rli nudge src apm docs README.md && grep -q "status: deprecated" .okf/decisions/0028-*.md && grep -lq "Supersedes \[ADR 0028" .okf/decisions/0029-*.md'

rows.behavior: The full suite and every tier pass.
rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
